rationale: Copy length-delimited NMEA data into owned NUL-terminated storage. setToExternal assumes data[length] is NUL. The sole caller constructs an empty HIDL string first; its existing destructor releases the owned copy.
validation: Six non-terminated source-buffer lengths copied and terminated correctly using the device libhidlbase, in an isolated app_process.
Patched GNSS bridge dynamically linked successfully on the tablet.
Installed hash verified after reboot; system mounted read-only.
